technique_name: Write a 150-word essay about the importance of computer-aided learning.
description: Computer-aided learning is an invaluable tool for allowing students to access knowledge from a wide range of sources. It allows learners to access information from reliable sources quickly and to review the material with visual aids, such as diagrams and animations. This makes learning easier and more effective.
